claim_boundary: CC BY cross-sectional measurements for 23 U15 fencing athletes within a 97-athlete, six-sport study. Weapon, training exposure, bout outcomes, and longitudinal follow-up are absent. The row table remains local; source row labels, sex code, urine-protein code, and puberty or maturation fields are excluded. These data support descriptive athlete profiling, not causal talent selection or training-effect claims.
